featured_reviews.name: Shwetal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is very good
Specially for soda but they also serve ice cream , milkshake, fruit beer and many more varieties.

It's always crowded the owner should think for other alternative for reducing the crowd.

Standing on foothpath and drinking soda create problems for other passerby too

They had kept dustbin but public is not using it many glasses are scattered around the road.

Parking is a big issues customers park anywhere on main road it causes problems.

It's reasonable in cost and worth to try

You should try double shot good drink need to consume in one go through...

featured_reviews.name: Shashank Dube
featured_reviews.review_text: Number one soda cold drink, available till 11 pm. Because of heavy crowd service is slow, but worth waiting. Visit once. ❣️❣️❣️

featured_reviews.name: Shwetal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place offer variety of soda, milk shake ,ice cream

But it's too crowded in the evening time and at this time of COVID -19 the owner should manage the crowd..

It's economically priced.

They don't wash the glass with any detergent they just remove from one water and serve to another customers...

Among the 2 person serving none of them use mask, hand gloves,cap...

So it's unhygienic to some extent.
